personality_one_liner: Earthy, trustworthy, and premium B2B agricultural commodity marketplace that feels native, modern, and data-driven.

spacing.rule: Generous iOS-native vertical spacing. Keep data tables breathable. Cards should not flush to screen edges; always use lg or xl padding. Thumb-zone sticky CTAs for main actions.

do's: Use glass on the bottom tab bar
Use frosted glass overlay on hero commodity cards placed over spice imagery
Sticky section headers for price tables should use glass with a tint
dont's: Never apply glass to regular list rows or data tables
Do not blur form fields or body text regions

screens.name: Beranda (Dashboard)
screens.purpose: Provide a quick overview of today's commodity market and real-time prices.

states.loading: Skeleton loading for hero card and price list.
states.error: Failed to fetch market data. Display retry button.

screens.layout: Hero section at top: A large featured card (Glassmorphism over a subtle earthy photo) showing the 'Indeks Harga' (Price Index). Below that, a horizontal scrolling list of top commodities (Jahe, Lada, Kunyit) with current price and green/red trend arrows. Followed by a 'Tren Terkini' section with a clean data table layout.

screens.name: Harga & Grafik (Prices)
screens.purpose: Deep dive into real-time price tables and historical trend charts for specific commodities.

states.empty: Illustration of an empty field with 'Belum ada data' message.

screens.layout: Sticky header. Main chart area using a clean, readable line graph (no noise). Below chart, a segmented control to switch timeframes (1H, 1B, 1T). Below that, a detailed table with 'Harga Beli' (Buy Price) and 'Harga Jual' (Sell Price). Data numbers must be crisp, aligned right.

screens.name: Cari Pembeli (Buyer Finder)
screens.purpose: Search, filter, and discover potential commodity buyers easily.

states.empty: Illustration of an empty box with 'Tidak ada pembeli ditemukan' message.

screens.layout: Top prominent search bar with filter icon. Horizontal scrollable filter chips below it (Komoditas, Lokasi, Harga). Main content is card-based directory listings showing Buyer Name, Distance, Desired Commodity, and Price Offered. Each card has a primary 'Hubungi' (Contact) button.

screens.name: Detail Pembeli
screens.purpose: View full details of a buyer and initiate contact.
screens.layout: Cover banner (photo or brand gradient) with gradient-to-dark scrim. Buyer name and verification badge overlaid. Content below: 'Kebutuhan Komoditas' (Commodity Needs), 'Lokasi Pengiriman' (Delivery Location), and terms. A sticky primary CTA at the bottom 'Hubungi Pembeli' (Contact Buyer).

hero_background.alt: Assorted fresh spices and agricultural commodities

buyer_empty_state.alt: Empty wooden crates representing no buyers found

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Lora for display text (App headers, big numbers, hero titles) and Plus Jakarta Sans for UI text (buttons, labels, tables).
Strictly follow the color palette. DO NOT USE ANY BLUE OR PURPLE anywhere in the app. Use the defined 'brand' (moss green) and 'brandSecondary' (terracotta) for all accents and CTAs.
Implement the gradient scrim pattern (transparent to surfaceInverse) for text overlaying any commodity/hero images.
For the 'Cari Pembeli' screen, make sure cards have clear visual hierarchy. Put the 'Hubungi' button on the right side or bottom of the card with the 'brandSecondary' color.
Data tables must be highly legible. Use generous padding inside table cells and avoid heavy borders (use 'divider' color at 0.5pt).
Keep navigation native. Use a bottom tab bar with 3 items: Beranda, Harga (Prices), Pembeli (Buyers).
Any 'loading' or 'error' state must take the full screen height (flex: 1) and be properly centered.
MOCKED IMAGES: Image fetching failed, so I have provided realistic Unsplash URLs as placeholders. Please use them as provided in the 'images' object.
